description: Commit to yourself / your life. Take control of your path. #selflove #selfimprovement
transcript: Life is exciting. The world is our oyster. We choose what path we go. We choose the direction. We choose the people. We choose the places and we choose the thing. There is no reason why you shouldn't be living the life that you want to live. Sterno World will always bring chaos. It is your responsibility to navigate the process the way that you need to, the way that works for you. It's not making things harder than what they need to be. It's just life.
